speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the chest skin lesion for me, including when you first noticed it and if it has changed in size or appearance?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed a spot on my chest about two months ago, and it seems to have gotten bigger since then. It doesn't hurt or itch at all, though. However, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: What does the lesion look like in terms of color, shape, and borders? Is it raised or flat, and does it have any specific features like ulceration or crusting?

speaker: Patient
text: It’s a dark, irregularly shaped spot with uneven borders that looks a bit raised compared to the surrounding skin. I haven’t noticed any open sores or crusting on it.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: Dermoscopy of the chest lesion.
